scope: AST-extracted exact project functions on synthetic fixtures, and aggregation of already saved JSON only. No model training, raw-data evaluation or opening an evaluation window.

quantile_zero_plateau.interpretation: Inclusive empirical CDF uses <=. The latest zero is at percentile 1 when all five prior values equal zero.

quantile_cold_bucket.interpretation: With fewer than five prior events, response does not affect the quantile label.

quantile_cross_bucket_inversion.interpretation: Relative CDF values across duration buckets can favour a zero response over a >50% positive response with 150 seconds played.

continuation_censoring.interpretation: Zeros past cap are removed from counts; there is no censoring mask. Remaining complete-session and observed-period continuation are different estimands.

same_time_truncation.interpretation: lexsort by (timestamp,item_id), followed by last-L truncation, keeps the larger raw IDs when a tied group crosses the context boundary.

query_age_invisible.interpretation: Gap embeddings encode gaps between observed events. Elapsed time from the last event to the query is absent; recency feature uses event positions.

auc_is_already_within_user.interpretation: Rejected pooled-AUC suspicion: implementation computes per-user AUC and averages over eligible users. It still covers only 261 users with both labels.
